 Responsibilities
 AWS Infrastructure Management: Demonstrated expertise in Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) on AWS. Responsible for designing, deploying, and managing AWS resources to ensure maximum performance, security, and cost optimization. 
 Administer GitLab, ensuring optimal configuration, maintenance, and support, while utilizing it for version control and designing and maintaining robust CI/CD pipelines. 
 Containerization and Orchestration: Extensive hands-on experience with Docker and containerization technologies. Skilled in Kubernetes administration, including managing EKS clusters, containerized applications, and orchestrating large-scale deployments. 
 Develop and manage infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform to provision and maintain resources efficiently. 
 Leverage Ansible to automate deployment processes and streamline configuration management tasks. 
 Develop scripts and tools in Python / Bash for automation and integration. 
 Set up monitoring and alerting using Prometheus for metrics collection. 
 Create dashboards and visualize data with Grafana. 
 Implement log aggregation and analysis with Loki. 
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth deployment and operation of systems. 
 Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure / application issues in a timely manner. 
 Proactively stay up-to-date on the latest DevOps trends, tools, and best practices. 
 Mentorship and Leadership Ability to mentor and guide junior team members, fostering skill development and promoting best practices within the team. 
 Qualifications
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience). 
 5+ years of experience in DevOps or related roles. 
 Extensive expertise in designing, implementing, and managing services in AWS, along with a deep understanding of cloud computing concepts. 
 Containerization & Orchestration: Docker, K8s. 
 Proficiency in GitLab, Terraform, Ansible, Python, Bash, Prometheus, Grafana, and Loki. 
 Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, automation, and infrastructure as code. 
 Secret Management: HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secret Manager 
 Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and critical thinking skills. 
 Strong communication and collaboration abilities.
